name: Chub
description: The chub, also known as the European chub, is an adaptable fish from the carp family. It is robust and occurs in various types of water bodies.
habitat: Chub are extremely adaptable and live in rivers, streams, lakes and ponds. They prefer areas with current and shelters like roots or overhanging branches.
diet: Omnivore - feeds on insects, smaller fish, crustaceans, worms and plant matter
features: Orange-red belly and anal fins in older specimens
conservation: Not endangered - widespread and common species
funFact: Chub are true opportunists! They eat almost anything - from insects to fruits to small mice that fall into the water. That's why they're also called 'water pigs'.
